newsitem.title: UK: UK 1996 cereals harvest estimated sharply higher.
newsitem.headline: UK 1996 cereals harvest estimated sharply higher.

text.p: The UKs 1996 cereal harvest will total 24.4 million tonnes according to the Ministry of Agriculture's (MAFF) first estimate of the harvest.
This was well up on 1995s 21.9 million tonnes and was partly due to the further reduction to 10% in the rate of obligatory set-aside for crops, the MAFF notice said.
Wheat yields (tonnes per hectare) were provisionally estimated to be about five percent up on last year whilst the area sown increased, also by five percent.
Barley yields were nearly nine percent higher and the cropped area increased by around five percent, MAFF said.
